title: Bethenny Frankel Shares First-Ever Photo Shoot With Her 15-Year-Old 'Peanut' - NewsBreak
text: It seems like just yesterday we were watching Bethenny Frankel get ready to welcome her daughter into the world, whom she affectionately nicknamed "Peanut." Well now little Bryn Hoppy is 15, and already turning heads like her mama. The former Real Housewives of New York star posted a behind-the-scenes video montage on both Instagram and TikTok on Wednesday, August 13 of her and her daughter, and captioned it, "My first ever photo shoot with the Peanut." The duo are decked out in New York Giants gear in the clip, showing that even though they recently moved to Florida, their team loyalty still lives in New York. But it wasn't the wardrobe getting all the attention — it was how stunningly beautiful Bryn is, and how much she is taking after Bethenny. One person wrote, "Gorgeous just like her mama," and another added, "Omg Brynn is gorgeous!!!!" There was also no shortage of heart emojis! 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 More fans added, "Your peanut is gorgeous," "You've done an amazing job in raising her. You can see so much happiness in the both of you right here," and, "Your daughter is gorgeous! #momgoals" Their makeup artist Jasen Kaplan also had the nicest thing to say about the pair: "Getting to glam you is always so much fun but I am so lucky to watch peanut grow up and turn into such a stunning, caring, compassionate, intelligent, SUPER MODEL! Wow…. Just wow!" Hair stylist Violet Gega also added, "It was my amazing experience, glomming your beautiful girl. She's the top model." Top model indeed!
